description:
In a game where the Winnipeg Jets were heavily outshot, facing a 34 to 20 shot disadvantage, they leaned heavily on Connor Hellebuyck. His performance included several crucial saves that played a pivotal role in securing the final playoff spot for the team. Hellebuyck's first significant stop occurred late in the second period when he extended his pad to deny Mats Zuccarello after a cross-ice pass, preserving Winnipeg's two-goal lead. Early in the third, during a Minnesota powerplay, Hellebuyck made a remarkable save on Kirill Kaprizov's redirection attempt, leaving Kaprizov in disbelief. With the Jets holding a 3-1 lead and just over a couple of minutes remaining in the game, Hellebuyck once again amazed everyone with an incredible stick save. This performance was all the more remarkable as Hellebuyck made his 13th consecutive start, demonstrating his indispensable role in the Jets' victory and their ultimate playoff spot.
